purpose: Every scripts/check-*.mjs file must be executed by something -- the Makefile, a root package.json script, or a .github/workflows/*.yml run: block -- or be recorded as a licensed exception with a reason, a who, and a when. docs/contract-inventory.json validates from its own entries outward (every entry's checker exists on disk) but nothing validated the reverse direction, so a checker script could exist, compile, and be well-tested in isolation yet never run as part of any real gate. This reuses scripts/lib/wiring-contract.mjs's evaluateWiring primitive (the orphan-detection engine scripts/check-test-wiring.mjs already runs for *.test.mjs files) and scripts/lib/executor-sources.mjs's shared Makefile+package.json+workflow scanner. The six operator-facing root commands are contract-gates, governance-audit, release-proof, perfect-fast, perfect-full, and perfect-live; all are directly invocable with `make <name>`, which is what matters for reachability coverage.

licensedExceptions.reason: This file's exported validation functions ARE wired and live: imported directly by scripts/check-live-evidence-currentness.mjs, scripts/import-live-evidence-manifest.mjs, scripts/live/run-live-evidence-campaign.mjs, and scripts/live/generate-live-evidence-manifest.mjs, and its own test file scripts/check-live-evidence-manifest.test.mjs (wired via `make live-evidence-currentness`, see Makefile:377) tests those exports directly. Only its OWN standalone CLI entrypoint (the `if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === ...)` guard at the bottom of the file, which reads spec/evidence/live-evidence-manifest.json by hand) is genuinely unreached by any Make target, npm script, or workflow -- it is a deliberate manual-operator convenience for validating a human-supplied live-evidence manifest before `scripts/import-live-evidence-manifest.mjs` runs, not a gate meant to run unattended.
